Synopsis:
King Harald of Norway died aged 89. His son Haakon VIII was automatically elevated to King and is set to take the constitutional oath before parliament. Public mourning is widespread. Monarchy support has risen to 72% post-Harald's death. Queen Mette-Marit (post-lung transplant) and the royal family will attend. State funeral set for September 9th in Oslo.
